info.name: Envestnet Aggregation APIs Account Token Associated Details API
Envestnet Fetch the details of a insights associated with an entity Id.

params.name: entityId
params.description: The unique identifier of the account or view.

params.name: entityType
params.description: The unique identifier of the entity type.

params.name: insightName
params.description: The unique identifier of insight Name. Comma separated multiple values can be passed.

items.docs: Retrieves details of all insights applicable for a given entity Id (viewId or accountId).

info.name: Envestnet Fetch the details of entities associated with an insight name.

params.name: insightName
params.description: The name identifier of the specific insight.

params.name: entityType
params.description: The unique identifier of entity Type. Comma separated multiple values can be passed.

items.docs: Retrieves details of all entity ids applicable for a given insight.
